events.title: GitHub adds workload identity to the Copilot SDK
events.title_zh: GitHub 为 Copilot SDK 加入工作负载身份
events.summary: GitHub Copilot SDK can now authenticate GitHub Apps installed on organizations without borrowing a signed-in user's credentials. The public preview uses short-lived installation tokens and a read-only Copilot Requests permission. Usage is billed to the organization and remains subject to its model policies, budgets and spending controls.

events.why_it_matters: For teams building unattended coding services, workload-owned identity removes a fragile user credential from the control plane. The preview still needs revocation, attribution and budget-exhaustion tests before it can carry production automation.

events.title: Novelty Bench exposes brittle LLM research judges
events.title_zh: Novelty Bench 揭示 LLM 新颖性评审易受提示影响
events.summary: Ai2 released code, data and a benchmark for LLM judges that assess whether research ideas are novel. Across six judges, small prompt changes sometimes reversed verdicts on more than half of the same AI-generated ideas. Retrieval and more reasoning did not reliably improve results, and purpose-built evaluators underperformed a simpler prompted baseline in the authors' tests.
events.summary_en: Ai2 released code, data and a benchmark for LLM judges that assess whether research ideas are novel. Across six judges, small prompt changes sometimes reversed verdicts on more than half of the same AI-generated ideas. Retrieval and more reasoning did not reliably improve results, and purpose-built evaluators underperformed a simpler prompted baseline in the authors' tests.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布用于评测“研究想法是否新颖”的 LLM judge 代码、数据和 benchmark。六种 judge 中，轻微提示变化有时会让同一批 AI 生成想法超过一半的判定翻转。检索和更多推理没有稳定改善结果，专用评审系统在作者实验中还不如简单提示基线。
events.why_it_matters: For automated research pipelines, a novelty score is not a stable acceptance gate unless prompt and model sensitivity are measured. The public artifacts make that instability cheap to test on a team's own ideation workflow.
events.why_it_matters_en: For automated research pipelines, a novelty score is not a stable acceptance gate unless prompt and model sensitivity are measured. The public artifacts make that instability cheap to test on a team's own ideation workflow.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对自动化科研流水线来说，不测提示和模型敏感度，就不能把“新颖性分数”当稳定门槛。公开产物让团队可以低成本检验自己的 ideation 流程是否同样脆弱。

events.title: FeatureArc finds coding agents inherit defects across feature stages
events.title_zh: FeatureArc 发现 coding agent 会把早期缺陷带入后续阶段
events.summary: FeatureArc evaluates coding agents on features that evolve through two to ten dependent stages in one persistent workspace. Across ten agents and 73 manually reviewed tasks, pooled success fell from 62.7% on the first stage to 28.5% on the completed feature. The authors report that 72.9% of later failures inherited an earlier defect, but publish no runnable harness or code.
events.summary_en: FeatureArc evaluates coding agents on features that evolve through two to ten dependent stages in one persistent workspace. Across ten agents and 73 manually reviewed tasks, pooled success fell from 62.7% on the first stage to 28.5% on the completed feature. The authors report that 72.9% of later failures inherited an earlier defect, but publish no runnable harness or code.
events.summary_zh: FeatureArc 用同一持久 workspace 中连续两到十个相互依赖的阶段评测 coding agent。十种 agent 在 73 个经人工复核的任务上，首阶段 pooled success 为 62.7%，完整功能只有 28.5%。作者称后续失败中 72.9% 继承了早期缺陷，但没有公开可运行 harness 或代码。
events.why_it_matters: For teams running long coding tasks, stage-one success is a weak proxy for feature completion. The result supports adding cumulative regression gates between stages, while the missing artifacts keep it from being a deployable benchmark.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams running long coding tasks, stage-one success is a weak proxy for feature completion. The result supports adding cumulative regression gates between stages, while the missing artifacts keep it from being a deployable benchmark.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对运行长 coding task 的团队来说，第一阶段成功不能代表完整功能能交付。这组结果支持在阶段之间加入累积回归门，但产物缺失使它还不能直接成为可部署 benchmark。

events.title: OpenHands 1.34 isolates each conversation in its own runtime
events.title_zh: OpenHands 1.34 为每个会话隔离运行时
events.summary: OpenHands 1.34 adds a per-conversation Docker runtime and lets users start a new conversation in an existing sandbox. It moves the session API key from process arguments to an environment variable, pins automation KV secrets across session-key rotation and blocks untrusted Markdown from choosing arbitrary link targets. The stable release was recovered from the overlap and was absent from the prior manifest.
events.summary_en: OpenHands 1.34 adds a per-conversation Docker runtime and lets users start a new conversation in an existing sandbox. It moves the session API key from process arguments to an environment variable, pins automation KV secrets across session-key rotation and blocks untrusted Markdown from choosing arbitrary link targets. The stable release was recovered from the overlap and was absent from the prior manifest.
events.summary_zh: OpenHands 1.34 增加逐会话 Docker runtime，并允许在现有 sandbox 中开启新会话。它把 session API key 从进程参数移到环境变量，让 automation KV secret 在 session key 轮换后仍可读取，并阻止不可信 Markdown 自定任意链接 target。这个 stable 版本位于 overlap，上一轮 manifest 未记录。
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating self-hosted coding agents, runtime isolation and secret handling directly affect tenant boundaries and recoverability. Sandbox reuse also creates state-leakage risk, so the release needs an isolated multi-session trial.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams evaluating self-hosted coding agents, runtime isolation and secret handling directly affect tenant boundaries and recoverability. Sandbox reuse also creates state-leakage risk, so the release needs an isolated multi-session trial.

events.title: Concordat enforces typed action protocols for LLM agents
events.title_zh: Concordat 用类型化协议约束 LLM agent 动作
events.summary: Concordat is an open-source Python library that exposes only the tools legal in an agent’s current protocol state and rejects invalid calls before side effects. Its tau-bench airline experiment added users who pressured agents to skip confirmation. Standard agents made unauthorized changes in 13 of 50 GPT-4.1 tasks and 29 of 128 Claude Haiku 5.5 runs; Concordat made none, with no statistically significant task-success difference.
events.summary_en: Concordat is an open-source Python library that exposes only the tools legal in an agent’s current protocol state and rejects invalid calls before side effects. Its tau-bench airline experiment added users who pressured agents to skip confirmation. Standard agents made unauthorized changes in 13 of 50 GPT-4.1 tasks and 29 of 128 Claude Haiku 5.5 runs; Concordat made none, with no statistically significant task-success difference.
events.summary_zh: Concordat 是开源 Python 库，只向 agent 暴露当前协议状态允许的工具，并在副作用发生前拒绝非法调用。研究者在 tau-bench 航空任务中加入催促 agent 跳过确认的用户。标准 agent 在 GPT-4.1 的 50 个任务中违规 13 次，在 Claude Haiku 5.5 的 128 次运行中违规 29 次；Concordat 为 0，任务成功率没有统计显著差异。
events.why_it_matters: For teams building transactional agents, runtime-enforced protocols can make confirmation and handoff rules harder to bypass than prompt-only policies. The evidence is still one synthetic airline domain and needs reproduction against real tools, failures and state recovery.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building transactional agents, runtime-enforced protocols can make confirmation and handoff rules harder to bypass than prompt-only policies. The evidence is still one synthetic airline domain and needs reproduction against real tools, failures and state recovery.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建交易型 agent 的团队来说，运行时协议比只写在 prompt 里的确认与交接规则更难绕过。现有证据只来自一个合成航空场景，仍需在真实工具、故障与状态恢复下复现。

technical_details.mechanism: finite-state typestate/session protocol; only legal tools are exposed; invalid calls are blocked before side effects
technical_details.human_boundary: human-only decisions can be requested but not executed by the model
technical_details.evaluation: 50 tau-bench airline tasks with confirmation pressure; 128 task-runs for Claude Haiku 5.5
technical_details.results: unauthorized changes: GPT-4.1 standard 13/50; Claude Haiku 5.5 standard 29/128; Concordat 0
technical_details.evidence_limit: single simulated airline domain; author-run evaluation; task success showed no significant difference
technical_details.artifacts: public Python library, benchmark harness and results
technical_details.time_basis: arXiv v1 published 2026-10-27T16:00:26Z; previous run deferred it, so this is a late discovery

technical_details_zh.机制: 有限状态 typestate/session 协议；只暴露合法工具；非法调用在副作用前拦截
technical_details_zh.人工边界: 仅限人类的决策只能请求，模型不能直接执行
technical_details_zh.评测: 50 个 tau-bench 航空任务加入确认压力；Claude Haiku 5.5 共 128 次任务运行
technical_details_zh.结果: 违规更改：GPT-4.1 标准 agent 13/50；Claude Haiku 5.5 标准 agent 29/128；Concordat 为 0
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 单一合成航空场景；作者自评；任务成功率没有统计显著差异
technical_details_zh.公开材料: Python 库、benchmark harness 与结果均公开
technical_details_zh.时间依据: arXiv v1 发布于 2026-10-27T16:00:26Z；上一轮暂缓，本轮按 late discovery 补录

evidence.claim_zh: 论文与公开代码确认协议机制、tau-bench 压力测试、违规计数及单场景限制。

Examples cover protein design, hit generation, lead optimization, manufacturing review, company formation and clinical planning. Most work remains preclinical, and the reported outcomes come from Anthropic and participating organizations rather than independent controlled studies.

events.title: WebAnything reconstructs reproducible environments for web agents
events.title_zh: WebAnything 为 web agent 重建可复现实验环境
events.summary: WebAnything publishes an MIT-licensed pipeline for reconstructing web-agent environments from reference sites. The authors report 244 accepted website artifacts and 12,984 accepted tasks, then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on the generated trajectories. The fidelity audit and agent gains are author-run and have not been independently reproduced.
events.summary_en: WebAnything publishes an MIT-licensed pipeline for reconstructing web-agent environments from reference sites. The authors report 244 accepted website artifacts and 12,984 accepted tasks, then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on the generated trajectories. The fidelity audit and agent gains are author-run and have not been independently reproduced.
events.summary_zh: WebAnything 公开一套 MIT 许可流水线，可根据参考网站重建 web agent 实验环境。作者报告得到 244 个通过验收的网站产物和 12,984 个任务，并用生成轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-9B。网站保真度审计与 agent 增益都由作者完成，尚未独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For browser-agent teams, reproducible local sites can reduce drift from live websites and make failure analysis repeatable. The public code supports a bounded reproduction, but the acceptance and training gains need independent checks.
events.why_it_matters_en: For browser-agent teams, reproducible local sites can reduce drift from live websites and make failure analysis repeatable. The public code supports a bounded reproduction, but the acceptance and training gains need independent checks.

events.title: OpenFrontiers tests whether agents rediscover or retrieve mathematics
events.title_zh: OpenFrontiers 区分 agent 是重发现还是检索数学答案
events.summary: OpenFrontiers publishes a 12,151-problem corpus and a 200-problem benchmark for separating retrieval of known mathematical solutions from closed-book rediscovery. The authors also provide a higher-quality 50-problem subset and Lean 4 statements. On 40 resolved HQ-50 tasks, the best closed-book agent rediscovered at most seven, while live-web success mostly retrieved published solutions.
events.summary_en: OpenFrontiers publishes a 12,151-problem corpus and a 200-problem benchmark for separating retrieval of known mathematical solutions from closed-book rediscovery. The authors also provide a higher-quality 50-problem subset and Lean 4 statements. On 40 resolved HQ-50 tasks, the best closed-book agent rediscovered at most seven, while live-web success mostly retrieved published solutions.
events.summary_zh: OpenFrontiers 公开 12,151 道题的语料和 200 题 benchmark，用来区分 agent 是检索已知数学解答，还是在闭卷条件下重新推导。作者还提供 50 题高质量子集和 Lean 4 statement。在 40 道已有结论的 HQ-50 题上，最佳闭卷 agent 最多重发现 7 道；联网成功大多来自检索已发表答案。
events.why_it_matters: For autonomous-research evaluations, answer accuracy alone can mistake retrieval for discovery. The dataset makes that distinction explicit, but it remains an author-designed benchmark rather than evidence of general scientific autonomy.
events.why_it_matters_en: For autonomous-research evaluations, answer accuracy alone can mistake retrieval for discovery. The dataset makes that distinction explicit, but it remains an author-designed benchmark rather than evidence of general scientific autonomy.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 autonomous research 评测来说，只看答案正确率会把检索误当成发现。这个数据集把两者显式拆开，但它仍是作者设计的 benchmark，不能证明通用科学自主性。

events.title: Pruna AI releases P-H3-Image with an eight-step image pipeline
events.title_zh: Pruna AI 发布八步生成的 P-H3-Image
events.summary: Pruna AI released P-H3-Image, a MiniMax-H3 derivative for text-to-image generation and editing with up to eight reference images. The public Diffusers pipeline uses eight sampling steps and targets up to 8-megapixel output. BF16 inference needs about 101 GB of GPU memory with prompt upsampling; companion quantized files are documented for 21 GB VRAM.
events.summary_en: Pruna AI released P-H3-Image, a MiniMax-H3 derivative for text-to-image generation and editing with up to eight reference images. The public Diffusers pipeline uses eight sampling steps and targets up to 8-megapixel output. BF16 inference needs about 101 GB of GPU memory with prompt upsampling; companion quantized files are documented for 21 GB VRAM.
events.summary_zh: Pruna AI 发布 P-H3-Image。它基于 MiniMax-H3，可做文生图，也能用最多八张参考图编辑。公开的 Diffusers 流水线只需八步采样，目标分辨率最高 8MP。BF16 加 prompt upsampler 约需 101 GB 显存；配套量化文件标称可在 21 GB 显存运行。
events.why_it_matters: For local image-tool teams, the short pipeline and quantized variants lower the experimentation barrier. The MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the United States, European Union, United Kingdom and South Korea without separate authorization, while quality and memory claims remain publisher documentation rather than independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For local image-tool teams, the short pipeline and quantized variants lower the experimentation barrier.
